'''Dan Christy Las Vegas 9-23 Director View (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Dan Christy]] posted on DeckTech on 23 September 2000 about [[September 2000 Las Vegas tournament (23 September)]].<ref name="tr-d1263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ las-vegas-9-23-director-view], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 23 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-23-las-vegas-9-23-director-viewd1263/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Dan Christy directed a nine-player, four-game tournament at Hobbytown USA in Las Vegas on 23 September 2000, won by Tim Guzman (8, +50) ahead of Matt Berta and Chris Hines.

== Original report ==

'''las-vegas-9-23-director-view'''
* '''Author:''' Dan "Mystikal" Christy
* '''Published:''' Sep 23, 2000

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  Prelude:  Stayed up waaaay too late and should have got more sleep. But I felt the need to go to 7-11 and get some food and stuff... at 1 AM. Got to sleep around 3. I set my alarm to get up around 8:30 but got up at 9:20 when the phone rings and John Spadora tells me he is coming to pick me up to go to the tourney. Half way there, I realize I forgot the prize support and I have no command cards. So we turn around, go to my house get the stupid CC packs and head to the store to make copies of the command cards. We get to Hobbytown USA around 10:15. Late. Even after I lectured Matt Berta about being there on time. My bad Matt. Anyways, Chris Hines (or Tim Guzman) got everyone ready, had them fill out cards and collected entry fees. Thanks guys. Anyways...



There were a wide variety  of decks for only having 9 people show up. Tim had BHBM and a cool Training deck. Chris had ROPS and HB with mains.



I saw for dark:

2 Court Of The Vile Gangster

1 TIE Swarm

1 BHBM

2 Hunt Down

1 ROPS

1 Set Your Course (saw Alderaan destroyed twice!!!)

1 ISB



And for light there was:

1 Profit

1 Training (cool deck Tim)

2 Hidden Base

1 Dantooine Operations (got matched up Vs. ROPS. It was a slow game)

1 Bespin Clouds

1 Elom Beatdown ("Matt’s ROPS Killa")

1 Crazy Mains n Toys (what do you call it Noah?)

1 There Is Good In Him



Tim "Info Broker" Guzman ended up winning the four game tourney, even though he only played 2 people (Noah Singer and Shane Watner). Matt Berta took second with Chris Hines in 3rd. The results were as follows:



1st: Tim Guzman 8(+50)

2nd: Matt Berta 6(+29)

3rd: Chris Hines 6(+15)

4th: Shane Watner 4 (+6)

5th: Noah Singer 4 (-15)

6th: John Tingley 4(-17)

7th: Ted Hansen 3 (-5)

8th: John Spadora 2(-36)

9th: Andrew Nelson 2 (-37)



Props:

Me for running a cool tournament.

Hobbytown for the hookup on DS2 deals for prize support.

John Tingley for making the trip from 29 Palms to play. And for destroying Alderaan 2 times.

Andrew Nelson for playing in his 1st tournament.

John Spadora for putting up with me needing to go to all those places (home and the store)

Hobbytown again for the new tables.



Slops:

Ted Hansen for spilling his Coke on the table.

Shane Watner for not beating Tim :)

Matt Berta for trying to cheat John Tingley (moving and then deploying your Traffic Control, C’mon!)



Overall it was a fun day. I can’t wait til the next tournament I run... who knows when that will be...



Dan Christy, Ordane Minister Of Death

( a title given to me in the church in Kingman, in case you are wondering)
</nowiki></div>
